excluded: visible UI mutation in this preflight

facts: The Path1 public page currently exposes block, count, seed, layout and answer-key controls but no practiceMode control.
The Path1 browser controller currently does not parse or write Path1-local query state and does not pass practiceMode into worksheet generation.
The public browser controller imports the P1-03 extension entrypoint rather than the base Path1 worksheet builder.
The P1-03 extension entrypoint currently delegates non-P1-03 blocks without forwarding a practiceMode argument.
The base Path1 worksheet builder already supports practiceMode=equalGroupsTransfer for P1-01/P1-02 and fails closed for unsupported blocks.
The Path1 manual page explicitly uses manual progression and does not implement automatic N-to-N+1 mastery advancement.

architectureDecision.summary: Add a Path1-local public adapter in the future cutover implementation. Arithmetic requests continue through the existing P1-03 extension entrypoint; equalGroupsTransfer requests for P1-01/P1-02 call the already implemented base transfer route directly. This avoids changing P1-03/P1-04 runtime semantics.

futurePublicControlContract.unsupportedBlockUiRule: Keep the control visible but disable equalGroupsTransfer outside P1-01/P1-02. If block selection changes while transfer is selected, normalize to arithmetic and surface one bounded status message.

path1BlockId.allowed: existing Path1 public worksheet block ids

parseRules: Absent parameters resolve to P1-01 + arithmetic.
Unknown block ids normalize to P1-01 and emit PATH1_PUBLIC_BLOCK_QUERY_FALLBACK.
Unknown practiceMode normalizes to arithmetic and emits PATH1_PUBLIC_PRACTICE_MODE_QUERY_FALLBACK.
equalGroupsTransfer paired with any block other than P1-01/P1-02 normalizes to arithmetic and emits PATH1_PUBLIC_TRANSFER_MODE_BLOCK_NOT_SUPPORTED.
writeRules: Write path1BlockId and normalized practiceMode together so legality is reproducible.
Do not serialize Path1 state through the Classic sourceId/questionMode selector query contract.
A block-change normalization must update both the control value and URL state.

modelingTransferGateContract.reason: The current Path1 page is a manual worksheet route with no mastery scorer or automatic N-to-N+1 controller. Generating or printing a transfer worksheet is practice evidence, not mastery evidence.
modelingTransferGateContract.p112AuthorityPreserved: P1-12 remains the formal required fusion point for total/number-of-groups/per-group unknown-role rotation.

node: Path1-local query parser/writer round-trips P1-01/P1-02 arithmetic and equalGroupsTransfer.
Invalid practiceMode and unsupported block/mode combinations normalize at the public query layer with bounded warnings.
Public adapter routes arithmetic through the existing P1-03 extension entrypoint.
Public adapter routes P1-01/P1-02 transfer through the existing implemented transfer builder.
Direct unsupported transfer requests fail closed.
Worksheet metadata records normalized practiceMode for both modes and preserves transfer relation metadata.
Default arithmetic question content remains unchanged aside from additive metadata.
P1-03/P1-04 output remains unchanged and never exposes transfer mode.
browser: Path1 page shows one practice-mode control with arithmetic default.
P1-01/P1-02 enable equalGroupsTransfer and generate application prompts with equation-bearing answer keys.
P1-03/P1-04 disable transfer selection and remain arithmetic-only.
Changing from P1-01/P1-02 transfer to an unsupported block normalizes the control and query state to arithmetic without runtime error.
Refresh restores path1BlockId + practiceMode from the Path1-local query contract.
Print preview question/answer counts remain aligned.

distance.distanceReduced: The remaining public-access ambiguity is reduced to one bounded Path1-local adapter + control + query-state cutover. The transfer runtime itself is not reopened.
remainingBlockers: Path1 local public adapter not implemented
mastery scoring remains outside current scope
